scripts.build: bun run build:stepwise && bun run build:lab
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/stepwise typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/interview-lab typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: bun run --cwd apps/stepwise test:e2e && bun run --cwd apps/interview-lab test:e2e
scripts.check: bun run check:kbui && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run --cwd apps/desktop prepare:runtime && bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri dev
scripts.test:native: bun run --cwd apps/desktop prepare:runtime && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:desktop: bun run --cwd apps/desktop prepare:runtime && bun run --cwd apps/desktop test:e2e && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.check:kbui: bun run --cwd apps/stepwise check:kbui && bun run --cwd apps/interview-lab check:kbui && bun run --cwd apps/desktop check:kbui
scripts.test:live-review: bun run --cwd apps/desktop prepare:runtime && bun run --cwd apps/desktop prepare && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib real_ollama_review -- --ignored --nocapture && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib real_review_through_native_ipc -- --ignored --nocapture && bun run --cwd apps/desktop verify:live
